disputes.statement: A prior E0 synthetic contract PASS coexists with a later terminal raw AuthorityBundle authority-chain failure; the latter is not ordinary WAIT_DATA.
disputes.resolution: Preserve both facts; start a new P0 route and do not repair or reopen the terminated route.
disputes.next_test: New non-self-authorizing synthetic validator and independent adversarial review.

disputes.statement: Historical governance and roadmap snapshots describe older active stages and cannot be treated as current program state.
disputes.resolution: Keep historical files immutable for this route and use the Sol reconstruction decision plus new stage contract as current precedence.
disputes.next_test: Validator must bind exact current decision and deny all later stages.

disputes.statement: ENTER_PROBE has been used both after response confirmation and before structural response completion.
disputes.resolution: Create separate policy namespaces for response-confirmed probe and any future early-absorption probe; neither is current action authority.
disputes.next_test: Define separate opportunity, label and risk contracts before any comparison.

disputes.statement: One historical linear chain orders ActionCandidate before PermissionEnvelope despite the action object requiring permission.
disputes.resolution: Use the object dictionary DAG: evidence receipt before scenario/utility, permission before action, result afterward.
disputes.next_test: Cross-object topology validation.

disputes.statement: No frozen mapping yet connects state/path beliefs to observable scenario distribution, trade thesis and action-specific outcomes.
disputes.resolution: Freeze typed objects now; freeze exact opportunity, scenario and action-outcome contracts before D3/E2.
disputes.next_test: Synthetic mutually-exclusive path-to-scenario mapping.

disputes.statement: Proper scoring was proposed for non-exclusive mechanism supports that have no observable mechanism truth label.
disputes.resolution: Use proper scores only for observable mutually exclusive scenario/action outcomes; mechanism support remains ordinal and is tested by ablation.
disputes.next_test: Validator rejects probability claims on mechanism contracts.

disputes.statement: Some historical synthetic mechanism definitions include response observations that may overlap their future labels.
disputes.resolution: Every measurement contract now separates antecedent, detection cutoff, confirmation and outcome windows.
disputes.next_test: Synthetic overlap and future-window mutations.

disputes.statement: Clock or revision invalidity was historically written as a market-mechanism falsifier.
disputes.resolution: Data invalidity makes a test inconclusive; only qualified contrary market outcomes can falsify a market hypothesis.
disputes.next_test: Enforce separate error_class and outcome fields.

disputes.statement: OTHER_PATH, UNKNOWN_PATH and ABSTAIN were previously combined despite being a market residual, epistemic state and action.
disputes.resolution: Keep OTHER_PATH and UNKNOWN_PATH in the path report; evaluate ABSTAIN in the policy and opportunity-cost report.
disputes.next_test: Cross-binding and coverage denominator tests.

disputes.statement: The 1W/1D/4H/1H/15m profile is frozen for one historical BTC profile but is not a universal market fact.
disputes.resolution: Treat it as a versioned current candidate; challenger profiles require new IDs and fair comparisons.
disputes.next_test: ClockProfile and simpler-profile ablation.

disputes.statement: Micro/short/medium decision clocks and daily/weekly context roles lack one formal refresh and staleness mapping.
disputes.resolution: Create ClockProfile with close time, available_at, maximum freshness and downward propagation.
disputes.next_test: Synthetic stale, unfinished-bar and synchronization cases.

disputes.statement: StructuralPosition contains position, strength, consumption and uncertainty but the latter three can leak future reactions.
disputes.resolution: Current P0 contract tests position only; strength, consumption and uncertainty receive independent versions and placebo zones.
disputes.next_test: Random/shifted-zone and past-only reaction-window controls.

disputes.statement: Historical policies conflict on whether a profit-locked target may extend.
disputes.resolution: Keep NO_TARGET_EXTENSION and PROFIT_LOCKED_EXTENSION as distinct policy namespaces with same-entry comparisons.
disputes.next_test: Synthetic monotone-risk test now; economic comparison only after E2.

disputes.statement: A legacy Confirmation.EXECUTION_READY field conflates confirmation and action permission.
disputes.resolution: Legacy object is historical; no direct mapping to current permission is allowed.
disputes.next_test: Validator rejects legacy execution-ready aliases in current IDs and permissions.

disputes.statement: A historical max-absolute group aggregator may prefer extreme noise while entropy/calibration targets are not yet available.
disputes.resolution: Compare max-absolute, representative-variable and regularized group models only after a calibrated scenario target exists.
disputes.next_test: Deferred calibrated aggregation ablation.

disputes.statement: Path and abstention challengers can improve scores by dropping difficult samples unless a gate-neutral master universe is frozen.
disputes.resolution: All challengers use one outcome-free master opportunity universe and report coverage-risk and abstention cost.
disputes.next_test: Validator requires common-denominator rule; E2 reports all opportunities.

disputes.statement: Historical authority bytes and prose-only hypothesis IDs are not fully cross-walked to current registries.
disputes.resolution: Do not rewrite historical contracts; retain hash-addressed locators when bytes exist and use explicit lineage fields for new hypotheses.
disputes.next_test: Future evidence curator creates a complete non-authorizing historical crosswalk.

disputes.statement: Registry digest declarations named a domain but did not state the domain-separator-canonical-json composition needed for independent reproduction.
disputes.resolution: All seven research registries/contracts now declare formula, UTF-8 domain prefix and separator byte 00; their self digests were recomputed under the declared formula.
disputes.next_test: Independent adversarial suite mutates domain, separator, content and digest independently.

disputes.statement: ER and RVOL originally lacked explicit zero-denominator and non-finite failure semantics.
disputes.resolution: ER and RVOL now return typed UNKNOWN on zero or invalid bases, non-finite inputs, insufficient history or incomparable units and cannot update downstream state or permission.
disputes.next_test: Synthetic all-flat prices, zero volume bases, missing and non-finite inputs must fail closed.

disputes.statement: The challenger position-size expression omitted per-unit worst cost and tail terms and left cap units ambiguous relative to current core theory.
disputes.resolution: The challenger now cites the current core q geometry, requires account-currency loss per executable unit and quantity-compatible caps, and preserves max_risk=0 at P0.
disputes.next_test: Future dimensional checker proves higher cost or tail cannot increase q and rejects incompatible units.

disputes.statement: The challenger introduced undeclared ordinal priors and weights and used a time constant formula while naming the parameter a half-life.
disputes.resolution: E0 starts at zero, forbids unregistered priors and weights, freezes deterministic max-absolute group aggregation, registers group and total caps, and uses exp(-ln(2)*age/half_life).
disputes.next_test: Strict contract rejects unknown aggregator/source types and later E2 compares alternatives only on development data.

disputes.statement: Hard falsifier and expiry prose exists for every hypothesis but is not yet a versioned executable predicate.
disputes.resolution: The gap is retained explicitly as NOT_YET_EXECUTABLE_BLOCKS_D3_E2; prose is design input only and cannot create an automatic score or outcome.
disputes.next_test: Before D3/E2, bind observable/operator/threshold/clock/window/censoring/terminal schemas and cross-implementation fixtures for every active hypothesis.
